routing.scope_rule: Current Production and current situation dominate durable navigation.
routing.production_switching: Transient scope-change surface; other Productions remain quiet rows rather than tile/card dashboard.

semantic_spaces.presentation: Within current Production; situation-first and contextual. Do not force Studio as a permanent top-level label.
Entered from current Scene/live context; Stage field becomes dominant and invariant dark. Stage may be a task destination without becoming mandatory durable global navigation.
History is discoverable/contextual/deep; current state remains retained. Do not make Archive/History a permanent top-level destination by default.

visual_roles.material: MAT F1 Subtractive Channel; one continuous authored field, edge-open negative channels, avoid repeated-card identity.

typography.packaging: Not yet a production font package; native scaffold may use a temporary platform fallback only as an explicit placeholder and must not treat it as visual acceptance.

focus_selection.selection: persistent structural inline-start edge witness where geometry permits
focus_selection.rule: focus and selection are independent and may coexist; accent may reinforce selection but never creates state meaning

platform_icons.rule: Use native/system source for these verbs; no bespoke Kymaean replacements.

stage.rule: Stage remains invariant dark. S1 is design-reference presentation only; do not invent a shipping asset pipeline or redraw Stage pixels.

must_demonstrate: native shell can represent current Production scope and current situation without provider/model vocabulary
internal routing capable of Studio semantic shaping, Live Stage, and Archive/history/deep inspection without reviving permanent Studio/Stage/Archive topology
deterministic local fixture/demo route with exact Back/Close navigation semantics and focus return
Light/Dark semantic parity around invariant dark Stage placeholder/reference
healthy persistence quiet; technical failure remains application/infrastructure truth
placeholder_permitted: system typeface in scaffold when Source Sans 3 production packaging is not yet available, explicitly marked non-final
dark Stage placeholder or local non-shipping S1 reference when shipping Stage asset packaging is not yet authorized
fixture content that does not invent unresolved Product commands
must_not: treat roadmap Studio/Stage/Archive names as mandatory permanent top-level tabs
expose E0 IDs/provider/model names in creator UI
make accent color carry status/truth/history/recovery semantics
claim browser reference dimensions as native Windows tokens

native_review_requirements: target-device screenshots or capture for Light and Dark
keyboard traversal evidence including focus/selection independence and return behavior
text scaling/localization stress once native typography exists
actual minimum-window behavior measured rather than inferred from browser 320px evidence
exact source/ref IDs for any Design asset consumed
non_authority: Resource dictionary key names and WinUI control classes remain Engineering implementation choices until native evidence exists.
Values above are implementation references, not final production token API.
Native runtime/accessibility/ARM64/package/Store claims require Engineering validation.
